defects.title: At touch, pill controls lose their 44px corners as tap targets; only DS-13 got the ::after fix, and the changelog says the guarantee holds
defects.evidence:
The test: on a fresh world (seed 12345, grid 256), tap 4px in from each corner and read elementFromPoint.

Tablet 1194×834 (corners.js, corners_strip.js):
- v2.73: every control below hits itself at all corners (0px radius).
- v2.74 misses all 4 corners of: #pinSave, #settlementsHeaderBtn, #assetsHeaderBtn, #pinPlanner (999px, 44px tall; hit lands on #toolOptsPins), #layersBtn (lands on #layersFab), the 3D button in #viewDimSeg (clipped by the seg's 999px overflow; lands on #mapBR), #findInput (lands on #findWrap), the strip's two year pills (68×44) and its three filter chips (88–108×44).

Phone 412×915 (corners_phone.js):
- v2.74: #findInput (346×44) misses 4 of 4 corners; #viewDimSeg's two end buttons each miss their two outer corners. All were ok on v2.73.

Why this contradicts the docs:
- CHANGELOG justifies the 12px touch radius with: "hit-testing follows border-radius, so a 44px pill loses its corners as targets, and v2.73's guarantee that a finger 4px in from a 44px control's corner still meets it … holds at 12".
- It then keeps these controls as pills ("Pills that stay pills at touch (.pill, the pins, the Base map chip, the 2D/3D square, DS-13)"; the search field is not even listed).
- Only `#zoomOverlay .zbtn::after` restores the box (ds13.js: all DS-13 corners hit).
- probe_fixpass's corner leg (~lines 655–664) presses only zoomOut, zoomIn, zoomReset, dockLeftCollapse, reseedBtn, genBtn and undoBtn, so it cannot see this.
defects.fix: Give each touch pill the DS-13 treatment: an empty, unclipped `::after{inset:0}` on the positioned control. For #viewDimSeg, put the target on the container or drop its overflow clip at touch. Or let these controls take the 12px touch radius. Then add every touch pill (pins, #layersBtn, #viewDimSeg, #findInput, the strip's .pill and filter chips) to probe_fixpass's corner leg and confirm that leg fails on today's bytes.

defects.title: The phone's quick-drawer rows are rounded 12px and their dividers curl at both ends, contrary to "rows … are squared by one rule"
defects.evidence:
drawer.js, 412×915 touch, drawer opened from the grip:
- #pinSave, #settlementsHeaderBtn, #assetsHeaderBtn and #pinPlanner (all in span#slotPhDrawer) measure 319×56 with border-radius 12px and borders 0/0/1/0 (top/right/bottom/left).
- On v2.73 the same rows are 0px.
- shots/drawer_crop_l_v74.png and drawer_crop_r_v74.png show each row's 1px bottom divider curving up at both ends.

The squaring rule (`.mb-row,.mb-panel > button,.layers-fab .lp-item,…,.civ-ctx button{border-radius:0}`) does not name the drawer rows, so they fall to `button{border-radius:var(--r-btn)}` (12px at touch).

The CHANGELOG says: "rows, tabs and the rail are squared by one rule, since a rounded full-width row curves its own divider". The CLAUDE paste says the same.
defects.fix: Add the drawer's rows to the squaring rule, scoped to the phone, e.g. `:where(html[data-shell="phone"]) #slotPhDrawer > button{border-radius:0}`. Add the drawer to probe_fixpass's square-row checks, alongside MENU's rows and .ph-tab.

defects.title: Phone MAP page: the full-width 2D/3D pill cuts its own armed chip's ring
defects.evidence:
On the phone's MAP sheet page, #viewDimSeg is 380×46 with radius 999px (rule `.to-pins button,#layersBtn,#findInput,.seg.viewdim{border-radius:var(--r-pill)}`).

The armed chip `.seg button.on::before{inset:2px;border-radius:calc(var(--r-btn) - 2px)}` is 10px at touch. The container's ~23px curve clips it. shots/viewdim_crop.png shows the accent edge broken at the chip's corners on the armed "2D".

#modeSeg directly below is 12px and its chip is intact (shots/modeseg_crop.png).

This is the clipping the CHANGELOG says drawing the chip inset avoids.
defects.fix: Keep the 999px radius for the single round 3D square in the map corner (desktop and tablet), and let the phone's full-width 2D/3D take --r-btn like #modeSeg. Alternatively, derive the chip's radius from its container.

defects.title: The new 2px focus ring is invisible on segmented buttons, so "the design's focus ring on every control" is overstated
defects.evidence:
focusseg.js at 1600×900: Tab onto WORLD's GENERATE segment.
- Computed style: `outline: solid 2px rgb(224,163,74)`, offset 2px, `:focus-visible` true.
- shots/focusseg_v74_x3.png shows no ring at all. `.seg{overflow:hidden}` clips the top, bottom and left; the next segment, a later z-index:0 sibling, paints over the right.

The V19 bar's six controls are not segments, so they pass. But the CHANGELOG and CLAUDE paste say "The design's focus ring on every control". Segments are the dock's most common control (26).

v2.73's Chrome auto ring was also faint, so the regression is small; the claim is what is wrong.
defects.fix: Draw the segment ring inside, e.g. `.seg button:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px}` or an inset box-shadow, as the menu rows already do. Add one segment to probe_fixpass's V19 leg.

defects.title: Stale or false comments (Ruling BK)
defects.evidence:
1. `_civBakeKey` comment: "(the LOD tile key, _lodViewKey's sibling above, has always carried it)". `_lodViewKey` exists nowhere; grep finds only this comment. The key is `_lodRenderKey`, which is in the file's first script block, not "above". The CHANGELOG names it correctly.
2. Radius block comment: "(the phone's app bar keeps its 44px Undo/Redo round, --r-btn, as the design's app bar does)". On the phone #undoBtn, #redoBtn and #phSearchBtn measure 44×44 at 12px, and probe_fixpass itself asserts "phone: the app bar's Undo takes the touch radius" (12px). The design's (Live.dc.html) are circles.
3. The accelerator comment above `if(_dskV(()=>_busyDepth,0)>0) return;` says "The overlay covers the map only, so a click on the dock's own Generate can still queue one, exactly as in v2.71". floatbusy.js at 900×800, with the left dock floating and open plus showBusy(): #genBtn is pressable on v2.73 and "covered by busy" on v2.74. The CHANGELOG's V11 bullet says both "a floating dock" (covered) and "It covers the map only".
4. renderNow: `_bootRenderPending=false;   /* v2.74 (P4): … */` is a comment appended after code; the RC style is one comment per line, on its own line.
5. probe_fixpass.js header lists "the touch radii 24/20px" among the literals it uses, but none appears; its touch literals are 12px.
defects.fix:
Correct each comment:
1. Name `_lodRenderKey` and its location.
2. Say "12px rounded squares, a stated departure from the design's circles".
3. Say a floating dock is covered and a docked dock is not.
4. Move the renderNow comment onto its own line.
5. Fix the probe header's literal list.
Also reconcile the V11 bullet's two statements.
